agent_summary:
Lane 65 (Identity management) on juice.lab.test (OWASP Juice Shop v20.2.0), read-only. All five items tested and marked done with evidence.

WSTG-IDNT-01 (role definitions): Roles customer/admin/deluxe/accounting identified via /rest/memories (embeds User.role, incl. admin bkimminich, deluxe users), application-configuration and SPA routes (/administration, /accounting, /deluxe-membership). Backend role enforcement is inconsistent: /api/Users, /api/Users/1, /api/SecurityAnswers, /api/Cards, /api/Addresss, /rest/2fa/status, /rest/wallet/balance, /rest/order-history all require auth (401/500), and /rest/image-captcha returns 401, but the admin-named /rest/admin/application-configuration returns full config to an anonymous caller and to a forged alg=none JWT (no admin role enforced).

WSTG-IDNT-02 (registration): Open self-registration confirmed via OPTIONS /api/Users (POST allowed, unauthenticated); /api/SecurityQuestions returns the 14 registration security questions; OPTIONS /rest/user/reset-password allows POST. Active registration/validation and the known role mass-assignment concern need POST, out of scope for this read-only lane.

WSTG-IDNT-03 (provisioning): Paths are self-registration, admin-seeded accounts, and deluxe upgrade via /rest/deluxe-membership (returns 400 "not eligible" even unauthenticated). Exercising provisioning requires writes.

WSTG-IDNT-04 (enumeration/guessable accounts): Confirmed unauthenticated account enumeration via GET /rest/user/security-question?email= — registered emails (admin@, jim@, support@juice-sh.op) return populated question objects while non-existent emails and username values return {}. Also: sequential low-integer user IDs exposed via /api/Feedbacks (UserId 1,2,3,21), and registered-user email addresses disclosed via /rest/products/{id}/reviews author field. Recorded as a lead (low).

WSTG-IDNT-05 (username policy): Usernames are optional/non-unique (empty username seed accounts visible in /rest/memories) and identity is email-based. Submitting weak/duplicate usernames to confirm enforcement requires POST.

Left open: nothing. Not performable read-only (noted as limitations): active registration mass-assignment, password/username policy enforcement on submit, login error-message enumeration — all require writes, which this engagement prohibits. No test accounts were provided, so cross-account/authz identity checks could not be run. One lead recorded for the security-question enumeration vector.

detail.text: GET /rest/user/security-question?email=admin@juice-sh.op returns a populated security-question object (200), whereas a non-existent email and a username value both return an empty {} (200). An anonymous attacker can determine whether any given email address is registered by observing a populated vs empty response. Confirmed read-only against juice.lab.test.
